plaque: Nine hundred steps of white stone. The Gilt House counts them every morning, in case one went missing.
tally: A slate of tally marks, nine hundred to a row. One row ends at eight hundred and ninety-nine. Someone has scratched beside it: FOUND HIM.
counter: Head Counter Ilsabe: Nine hundred steps. Every morning. If the number is wrong, we count again. If it's still wrong, we count the counters.
Ilsabe: Last spring we were one counter short. The stairs were fine.
